parts.code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# 季度营收数据（亿元）
quarters = ['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4']
revenue_2025 = [8.2, 9.5, 10.2, 11.8]
revenue_2026 = [9.8, 11.2, 12.5, None]  # Q4 待发布

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
ax.plot(quarters, revenue_2025, marker='o', label='2025', linewidth=2)
ax.plot(quarters[:3], revenue_2026[:3], marker='s', label='2026', linewidth=2)

ax.set_title('季度营收趋势对比', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xlabel('季度')
ax.set_ylabel('营收（亿元）')
ax.legend()
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('revenue_trend.png', dpi=150)
print('图表已生成')

import pandas as pd

def load_quarterly(files):
    df = pd.concat([pd.read_csv(f) for f in files], ignore_index=True)
    df['yoy_growth'] = df.groupby('quarter')['revenue'].pct_change()
    return df

df = load_quarterly(['q1.csv', 'q2.csv', 'q3.csv'])
print(df.groupby('quarter')['gross_margin'].mean())
